title: POST image endpoints silently rewrite out-of-range seeds to seed 42 (and bill for it)
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: Added seed validation to POST /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits: seeds must be integers from -1 through 2147483647, or null. Invalid values now receive a 400 response instead of producing an image with a substituted seed. The API docs now describe the field and note that -1 maps to the stable compatibility seed.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
